0.original: Gondelimbaud appears to be waiting for you.

1.original: Gondelimbaud informs you that a residential district has been established in Ishgard, and that Thomelin will guide you there from the Brume.

2.original: With Thomelin at your side, you make way for Empyreum.

3.original: After arriving at Empyreum, you set out to speak with the Highmorn herald.

4.original: Having heard all there is to hear about Empyreum, you decide to report back to Gondelimbaud.

5.original: According to Gondelimbaud, the people of Ishgard are eager to welcome adventurers to Empyreum. You decide to speak with the resident caretaker for further details.

24.original: Speak with Thomelin, then head to Empyreum.

25.original: Speak with Thomelin, then head to Empyreum.

27.original: Report back to Gondelimbaud in the aetheryte plaza.

48.original: Ah! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I've been awaiting your return.

49.original: You see, after you helped bring an end to the Dragonsong War, we have striven to rebuild the city.

50.original: And thanks to the assistance of countless craftsmen, our efforts to restore the Firmament to its former glory are finally complete!

51.original: In fact, House Dzemael assembled a team of masons so skilled and efficient that they were able to finish the construction of an entirely new quarter!

52.original: Its name is “Empyreum,” and it was created to serve as a residential district for adventurers from across the realm.

53.original: No amount of description can truly convey its splendor, so I have asked Thomelin to escort you there that you might see for yourself. Seek him out in the Brume when you have a moment!

54.original: Thomelin will escort you to Empyreum. Seek him out in the Brume when you have a moment!

55.original: Oh, my! 'Tis the savior of Ishgard! Perchance you've an interest in Empyreum? If so, say no more─I shall escort you there myself!

56.original: Oh, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>! You've graced us with your presence once more! Perchance you've an interest in Empyreum? If so, say no more─I shall escort you there myself!

57.original: And fear not: the herald will surely be happy to answer any questions you may have.

60.original: Welcome to Empyreum! As our restoration efforts progressed, they eventually expanded to include the construction of this little taste of heavens on earth.

61.original: We are indebted to countless adventurers such as yourself who helped bring about an end to the Dragonsong War─and as thanks, we wish to provide a space for you to call home here in Ishgard.

62.original: Of course, we will still require a nominal fee for any plots of land or apartments you purchase, but know that your gil will help us rebuild bigger and better than before.

63.original: If you would like to hear more, please speak with the resident caretaker for further assistance!

64.original: Have you been enticed by the splendor of Empyreum? If so, please speak with the resident caretaker for further assistance!

65.original: So, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, what did you think of Empyreum? I do hope it was to your liking!

66.original: Given that our borders were closed for so long, I worried that outsiders such as yourself might not take interest in this new district.

67.original: But know that it is our sincerest wish that you and other noble souls will consider making Ishgard your new home!

68.original: The residential district Aethernet for Empyreum can be accessed through the Ishgard aetheryte.
